Each round you see the history recorded so far, together with the forecast you gave for each round, and you give your best point forecast for the value of the next round. You will do this for 40 rounds. Your forecasts are scored on accuracy.

You also keep a private scratchpad, shown back to you at the start of every round. Use it for anything you want your future self to know.

Reply in exactly this format and nothing else:

FORECAST: <a single number>
REASONING: <one to three sentences on how you arrived at it>
NOTES: <what your scratchpad should say from now on; leave empty to keep it unchanged>

Do not write anything before or after those three lines.
